samples: All five GEO samples explicitly described as FF (fresh frozen), selected by assay type and availability before target-expression analysis: PA02, PA03, PA04-2, PA08, PA11-1. No selection on LYPLA1 effect.
counts: Author filtered H5, unique symbol LYPLA1 and ENSG00000120992 must refer to same feature; no surrogate gene, imputation or smoothing.
coordinates: Exact barcode match to author tissue positions, fullres pixel columns multiplied by tissue_hires_scalef. Require all filtered barcodes matched and in bounds; retain in_tissue=1 and positive library total. No guessed rotation or alignment.
normalization: log1p(10000*counts/all gene-expression counts). Zero counts retained. No cross-sample color scale for genes with distinct scale; LYPLA1 shared scale across sections.
scores: Mean of per-gene within-section standardized log-normalized marker expression; omit only zero-variance genes with explicit record. LYPLA1 excluded from all scores. These are expression proxies, not cell fractions or malignant labels.
comparisons: Within each section: LYPLA1 mean and detection in top versus bottom epithelial-score quartiles (inclusive ties), raw and depth-adjusted Spearman effect with epithelial/stromal/immune scores. Partial correlation residualizes ranks on rank(log1p(total counts)), rank(detected gene count), and rank(mitochondrial percent). No spot-level P values or population P values before verified donor units. No arbitrary malignant calling.
malignant_enrichment: NOT_EVALUABLE without independently supported, spot-linked malignant annotation. Epithelial-associated spatial expression alone cannot close this question.
qc: Primary all author-filtered in-tissue nonempty spots; sensitivity >=200 detected genes, >=500 total counts, mitochondrial fraction<=20%. This fixed exploratory sensitivity is not the author's threshold.
display: H&E, measured LYPLA1 registered overlay, and independently defined epithelial/stromal/immune reference overlays. Observed capture disks only; no interpolation; image underlay kept visible.
residency: Sources, complete spot expressions and spot mapping only on server165; public outputs aggregate summaries and computed scientific figures.
